newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM CHEERS FINNYARDS ICEBREAKER ORDER.
newsitem.headline: UPM CHEERS FINNYARDS ICEBREAKER ORDER.

text.p: Finnish forestry group UPM-Kymmene Oy on Thursday welcomed an icebreaker order worth over 300 million markka received by its troubled associated company Finnyards.

"The order diminishes fears (about Finnyards' future)," UPM general council and Finnyards board member Reko Aalto-Setala told Reuters by telephone, when asked for comment on news that the expected icebreaker order from the Finnish board of navigation had been confirmed.
UPM is the biggest owner in Finnyards with 48 percent of shares.
Aalto-Setala said there had been a need for a new order since Finnyards' order backlog was expected to fall sharply after 600 million markka deliveries due next April.
"There is still room for more," he added.
Finnyards said earlier its current order backlog including the new icebreaker order amounts to 1.3 billion markka.
